description.name: Crystal Force I
description.text: One single attack (10.00 each) capped at 199999, grants [Damage Cap +10000 2], [Quick Cast 2], [Physical +30% Boost 2], [DEF and RES 50% Piercing 2], and [200% ATB 1] to the user

description.name: Crystal Force Mode: Celes (Holy)
description.text: Holy abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Holy abilities trigger 1 additional time, [DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)], removed if the user hasn't Crystal Force Mode

description.name: DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking

description.name: Crystal Force Mode
description.text: Grants Crystal Force Mode, Replaces Attack and Defend commands with Crystal Force I & II, unlocks II after three actions
